paper_title: Search for light scalar Dark Matter candidate with AURIGA detector
notes: AURIGA resonant-mass detector searches for scalar moduli DM. The limit constrains both electromagnetic gauge modulus (d_e, ScalarPhoton) and electron mass modulus (d_me, ScalarElectron) equally - the paper reports a combined limit d_i <~ 1e-5 in the band f=[850,950] Hz. Mass range: f_phi = m_phi/2pi, so f=850Hz -> m~3.52e-12 eV, f=950Hz -> m~3.93e-12 eV (using m[eV]=4.136e-15*f). Central value m_phi=3.6e-12 eV. Only text values available (Fig 5 not numerically readable). Coupling type ambiguous between ScalarPhoton (d_e) and ScalarElectron (d_me); chose ScalarPhoton per hint but limit applies to both. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.6, 2))
